title: Rookie DE Mikail Kamara tore his ACL at 49ers' practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rookie DE Mikail Kamara tore his ACL at 49ers' practice
sources.description: 49ers rookie defensive end Mikail Kamara, who was carted off the practice field Saturday, was diagnosed with a torn ACL, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
